subject: math.GM
name: Pythagorean theorem
statement: In a Euclidean right triangle with perpendicular side lengths a and b and hypotenuse length c, a²+b²=c².

subject: math.GM
name: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic
statement: Every integer greater than 1 can be written as a product of primes, and this factorization is unique up to the order of the factors.

subject: math.GM
name: Euclid’s theorem on primes
statement: There are infinitely many prime numbers.

subject: math.GM
name: Irrationality of √2
statement: There are no integers p and q with q ≠ 0 such that (p/q)²=2; hence √2 is irrational.

subject: math.GM
name: Binomial theorem
statement: For every nonnegative integer n and real or complex numbers x and y, (x+y)ⁿ = Σ from k=0 to n of binom(n,k)x^(n−k)yᵏ.

subject: math.GM
name: Geometric series theorem
statement: For a real or complex number r with |r|<1, the infinite series Σ from k=0 to infinity of rᵏ converges to 1/(1−r).

subject: math.GM
name: Intermediate value theorem
statement: If f is a continuous real-valued function on [a,b], then every value between f(a) and f(b) equals f(c) for some c in [a,b].

subject: math.GM
name: Mean value theorem
statement: If a<b and a real-valued function f is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b), then some c in (a,b) satisfies f′(c)=(f(b)−f(a))/(b−a).

subject: math.GM
name: Fundamental theorem of calculus
statement: If f is continuous on [a,b], then F(x)=∫ from a to x of f(t)dt is differentiable on (a,b) with F′(x)=f(x). If G is continuous on [a,b], differentiable on (a,b), and satisfies G′=f there, then ∫ from a to b of f(x)dx=G(b)−G(a).

subject: math.GM
name: Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem
statement: Every bounded sequence in Euclidean space ℝⁿ has a convergent subsequence.

subject: math.GM
name: Heine–Borel theorem
statement: A subset of Euclidean space ℝⁿ is compact if and only if it is closed and bounded.

subject: math.GM
name: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality
statement: For vectors x and y in a real or complex inner product space, |⟨x,y⟩|² ≤ ⟨x,x⟩⟨y,y⟩. Equality holds if and only if x and y are linearly dependent.

subject: math.GM
name: Arithmetic–geometric mean inequality
statement: For nonnegative real numbers x₁,…,xₙ with n ≥ 1, (x₁+⋯+xₙ)/n ≥ (x₁⋯xₙ)^(1/n). Equality holds if and only if all the numbers are equal.

subject: math.GM
name: Cantor’s uncountability theorem
statement: The real numbers cannot be listed in a sequence indexed by the positive integers; in particular, the interval [0,1] is uncountable.

subject: math.GM
name: Cantor–Schröder–Bernstein theorem
statement: If there is an injective map from a set A to a set B and an injective map from B to A, then there is a bijection between A and B.

subject: math.GM
name: Fermat’s little theorem
statement: If p is prime and a is an integer, then aᵖ ≡ a modulo p. If p does not divide a, this is equivalent to a^(p−1) ≡ 1 modulo p.

subject: math.GM
name: Euler’s theorem in number theory
statement: If n is a positive integer and the integer a is relatively prime to n, then a^φ(n) ≡ 1 modulo n, where φ(n) is the number of integers in {1,…,n} relatively prime to n.

subject: math.GM
name: Fundamental theorem of algebra
statement: Every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has a complex root. Consequently, a polynomial of degree n ≥ 1 factors over the complex numbers into n linear factors, counted with multiplicity.

subject: math.GM
name: Rank–nullity theorem
statement: If V is a finite-dimensional vector space and T:V→W is linear, then dim(V)=dim(ker T)+dim(im T).

subject: math.GM
name: Euler’s polyhedron formula
statement: For every convex three-dimensional polyhedron, its numbers V of vertices, E of edges, and F of faces satisfy V−E+F=2.
